svg.aria-label: Side view of the goal: the rock from Chapter 31 with its spray, and to its right the boat, which pitches, rolls and heaves on the waves and is driven by the arrow keys. Spray flies at its bow when it drops into a wave, and a wake of foam fades behind it.
